bibl.title: The Text and Function of P. Berol. 11710 Revisited.
bibl.seg: Joseph E. Sanzo & Lorne R. Zelyck, The Text and Function of P. Berol. 11710 Revisited.
bibl.note: 1. Brief description of P. Berol. Inv. 11710 (= van Haelst 591; LDAB 6211). - 2. Text, translation, and notes. - 3. The "Johannine" character of P. Berol. Inv. 11710. - 4. The apotropaic or curative function of P. Berol. Inv. 11710: 4.1. Unusual features; - 4.2. P. Berol. Inv. 11710 and P. Oxy. XI, 1384 (= MP3 2410; Marganne 136; LDAB 3237); - 4.3. Concluding reflections on the function of P. Berol. Inv. 11710. - 5. Implications of apotropaic/curative function: 5.1. Does P. Berol. Inv. 11710 preserve an apocryphal gospel?; - 5.2. "Walk in the sun / 'Êli?'?". - 6. Conclusion.
